Ticket S267.2-2 promised a divergence warning and delivered half of it. | resolveTrunkRef prefers the local trunk's configured upstream (main@{upstream}), then the remote's recorded default branch (refs/remotes/origin/HEAD), then the local branch, then HEAD, reporting which source won and how far the local trunk is behind. findShippedSprintsOnMain scans through it. Scored as a miss: the security regression shipped into the working tree and was caught by an existing test, not by design. |
| S267.2-2 | Wedge | Green | -- | slope roadmap validate now prints which ref it scanned and how far the local trunk is behind, but only when they have actually diverged — a quiet no-op in the main checkout, informative in a worktree. Divergence is the condition that makes shipped-commit detection meaningless, so it belongs next to the result, not in a separate command. |
| S267.2-3 | Short Iron | Green | Rough: mkdtempSync appends a random suffix to its argument, so mkdtempSync(join(root,'origin')) does not create 'origin' — it creates 'originAbC123'. Every git command then ran in a non-existent cwd and surfaced as `spawnSync cmd.exe ENOENT`, which reads like a missing git rather than a missing directory. Use mkdirSync for a known path.; Rough: [code review] Consolidating the tokenizers spread a fail-open path to phase-boundary, which can deny: an unterminated heredoc discarded the rest of the invocation so the guard saw nothing. | tests/core/analyzers/trunk-ref.test.ts builds a real origin, a clone whose local main is deliberately left behind, and a worktree off that clone. Asserts the merged sprint is found from both the clone and the worktree, and that the two agree — the four consumers (roadmap validate, slope status, slope retro, post-hole-enforcement) all read one helper, so agreement at the helper is agreement everywhere. |

Every git command then ran in a non-existent cwd and surfaced as `spawnSync cmd.exe ENOENT`, which reads like a missing git rather than a missing directory. Use mkdirSync for a known path. |
| Rough | S267.2-3 | [code review] Consolidating the tokenizers spread a fail-open path to phase-boundary, which can deny: an unterminated heredoc discarded the rest of the invocation so the guard saw nothing. |

**Known hazards for future sprints:**
- src/core/analyzers/git.ts findShippedSprintsOnMain: an explicit ref argument must be scanned alone. Appending the default candidates after it turns an unsafe-ref rejection into a silent scan of a different branch.
- Node's mkdtempSync appends a random suffix; it never creates the exact path passed to it. In git fixtures the resulting ENOENT surfaces as a spawn failure and reads like a missing binary.
